newsitem.title: FINLAND: HARTWALL J/V TO BUY HALF OF UKRAINE FIRM.
newsitem.headline: HARTWALL J/V TO BUY HALF OF UKRAINE FIRM.

text.p: Finnish beverages company Oy Hartwall Ab said in a statement on Thursday its joint venture Baltic Beverages Holding AB (BBH) will buy 50 percent of Ukrainian brewery Slavutich for $10 million.
"Fifty percent of the share capital will be transferred to BBH for a $10 million subscription price," Hartwall said.
BBH aims to further raise its holding in Slavutich later, it said.
Hartwall said Slavutich's share capital will double through a directed share issue to BBH.
Slavutich is the second largest brewery in Ukraine with an annual capacity of 75 million litres and 600 employees, it said.
There are about 30 million inhabitants living within a distance of 300 kilometres from the brewery, Hartwall said.
Hartwall holds 50 percent of BBH, and Swedish-Norwegian Pripps-Ringnes AB holds the other half.
